name: Miracle Of Birth
overview: The miracle of birth reveals God's intimate involvement in human life, as He carefully fashions each person, even within the womb, demonstrating His sovereign craftsmanship (Psalms 139:13; 119:73). This divine handiwork reflects the majesty of the Creator who ordained the heavens and the stars (Psalms 8:3). Trusting and delighting in the Lord assures believers that He faithfully brings His purposes to pass in their lives (Psalms 37:4-5), warranting heartfelt praise for His wondrous works (Psalms 113:1).
